requirements.business_goal: İnternet ve bayi kanallarının satış performansını yönetime sunmak

datasets.description: 2013 internet satış KPI'ları ve 2012'ye göre değişim
datasets.sql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT d.CalendarYear AS yr,
         CAST(SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS float) AS sales,
         COUNT(DISTINCT f.SalesOrderNumber) AS orders,
         CAST(SUM(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalProductCost) AS float) AS profit,
         COUNT(DISTINCT f.CustomerKey) AS customers
  FROM dbo.FactInternetSales f
  JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey = f.OrderDateKey
  WHERE d.CalendarYear IN (2012, 2013)
  GROUP BY d.CalendarYear
)
SELECT c.sales AS sales_amount, (c.sales - p.sales) / p.sales AS sales_growth,
       c.orders AS order_count, (c.orders - p.orders) * 1.0 / p.orders AS order_growth,
       c.profit / c.sales AS gross_margin, c.profit / c.sales - p.profit / p.sales AS margin_change,
       c.customers AS active_customers, (c.customers - p.customers) * 1.0 / p.customers AS customer_growth
FROM p c JOIN p p ON c.yr = 2013 AND p.yr = 2012

datasets.description: Aylık internet satış tutarı ve sipariş sayısı (2012–2013)
datasets.sql:
SELECT CONVERT(char(7), d.FullDateAlternateKey, 126) AS year_month,
       CAST(SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS float) AS sales_amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.SalesOrderNumber) AS order_count
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales f
JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey = f.OrderDateKey
WHERE d.CalendarYear IN (2012, 2013)
GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), d.FullDateAlternateKey, 126)
ORDER BY year_month

SELECT t.SalesTerritoryGroup AS territory_group, t.SalesTerritoryCountry AS country,
       CAST(SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS float) AS sales_amount
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales f
JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey = f.OrderDateKey
JOIN dbo.DimSalesTerritory t ON t.SalesTerritoryKey = f.SalesTerritoryKey
WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2013
GROUP BY t.SalesTerritoryGroup, t.SalesTerritoryCountry
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC

SELECT pc.EnglishProductCategoryName AS category, t.SalesTerritoryGroup AS territory_group,
       CAST(SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS float) AS sales_amount
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales f
JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey = f.OrderDateKey
JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
JOIN dbo.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN dbo.DimProductCategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = ps.ProductCategoryKey
JOIN dbo.DimSalesTerritory t ON t.SalesTerritoryKey = f.SalesTerritoryKey
WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2013
GROUP BY pc.EnglishProductCategoryName, t.SalesTerritoryGroup

datasets.description: Kanal bazında aylık satış: internet ve bayi (2012–2013)
datasets.sql:
SELECT CONVERT(char(7), d.FullDateAlternateKey, 126) AS year_month, N'İnternet' AS channel,
       CAST(SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS float) AS sales_amount
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales f JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey = f.OrderDateKey
WHERE d.FullDateAlternateKey BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2013-11-30'
GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), d.FullDateAlternateKey, 126)
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(char(7), d.FullDateAlternateKey, 126), N'Bayi', CAST(SUM(r.SalesAmount) AS float)
FROM dbo.FactResellerSales r JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey = r.OrderDateKey
WHERE d.FullDateAlternateKey BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2013-11-30'
GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), d.FullDateAlternateKey, 126)
ORDER BY year_month

SELECT TOP 10 p.EnglishProductName AS product, ps.EnglishProductSubcategoryName AS subcategory,
       CAST(SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS float) AS sales_amount, SUM(f.OrderQuantity) AS quantity,
       CAST(SUM(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalProductCost) AS float) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS float), 0) AS gross_margin
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales f
JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey = f.OrderDateKey
JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
JOIN dbo.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2013
GROUP BY p.EnglishProductName, ps.EnglishProductSubcategoryName
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC
